title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Shah
description: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-ready RAG + agent quickstarts to help engineers onboard faster and reduce repeated implementation work across teams. This PR includes: 1) a set of RAG agent templates (authoring patterns for retrieval, prompt templates, and tool integration), 2) two tool-calling agent examples (TypeScript and Python) demonstrating structured tool responses and error handling, 3) docs site updates: quickstart pages, sidebar entries, and a short tutorial with code snippets and expected outputs, and 4) small improvements to the examples README and tests. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates under redwood-examples/templates/rag - [x] Add TS and Python agent examples under redwood-examples/agents - [x] Docs site pages and sidebar updated - [x] Unit tests for example harnesses - [x] Lint and spellcheck fixes The description of the templates: each template includes a retrieval config (embedding model, chunking hints), a prompt template with safety/clarity guidelines, and example mappings for tool calls (search, knowledge-base lookup, calendar). The examples show how to register tool schemas with the agent, handle tool errors, and surface structured responses back to callers. Related: ENG-4321 (template packaging), PM-112 (doc quickstart scope). Quick links: internal preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates. Notes: minimal surface-area change to the runtime — examples use existing SDK APIs. No breaking changes.
